messages.text:
There are already a lot of temporary drive mappings on this machine, and `T:` was occupied.

I’ll borrow one mapping just for this install/build cycle and restore it afterward; the files still stay in the current project directory.

commands.commandLine: "C:\\Program Files\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe" -Command 'subst T: /D; subst T: "$((Resolve-Path .).Path)"; subst T:'
